name: avatar-imaging-pixinode
description: Spike: render Nitro avatars server-side with @pixi/node (real WebGL, no headless browser).
comment: The renderer is consumed via Vite aliases (see vite.node.config.mjs) and @pixi/node is inlined into dist-node/boot-node.mjs at build time, so @pixi/node and pixi.js are BUILD-only (devDependencies). The runtime bundle imports only the native addons gl + canvas (kept external), which stay in dependencies with upng-js (APNG) and express (HTTP). This keeps the Docker runtime image to the runtime deps only.
